paper_title: Minimum Common String Partition: Exact Algorithms
classifications: Theory of computation → Parameterized complexity and exact algorithms
Theory of computation → Algorithm design techniques
statement: There are three natural questions left open by the present studies. 1. Close the gap between a lower bound 2Ω(n/ log n) and an upper bound 2O(n log log n/ log n) for constant size alphabets. 2. Design a moderately exponential time (of the form cn for c < 2) algorithm for the case of more than two input strings. 3. Roughly, it is the “no-holes” property that allows us to improve the 2n upper bound for MCSP. What are other problems with the same effect?
